steps.content:
Going by these two pages, I can't give you a real reason to pick one seller over the other. The listings are identical on everything they show.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite | Same |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The two listings even show the same rating and the same number of reviews. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to the seller. If so, they tell you nothing about either seller's service.

Some things could matter that the pages don't show:
- **Seller reputation:** Look for independent seller ratings or reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio, such as shipping reliability and how they handle returns.
- **Authorized retailer status:** Check whether either seller is an authorized Quellwyn reseller. That can affect whether the warranty is honored.
- **Total cost:** Check at checkout for differences in tax or fees.
- **Return handling:** Check whether either seller charges a restocking fee. The pages don't mention one.

If you want a tiebreaker, choose the seller with the better independent reputation. If you can't find any difference, either one is fine, and you can just buy from whichever you find more trustworthy. If you paste in any extra information, like seller reviews or checkout details, I can compare them again.
